title: Sehrgar kuch kartalari qizil-qora uslubda: Sehrli yurak, Muz qalqoni, Ikki karra teleport

steps.eval: const score = g.score; const all = new Map(); for (let k = 0; k < 80 && all.size < 11; k++) { g.stage = 'fight'; g.enemies = []; g.update(0.016); for (const u of g.choices) all.set(u.id, u); } g.choices = ["heart", "thorns", "dash2"].map((id) => all.get(id)).filter(Boolean); g.choiceIndex = 0; g.upgradeLock = 0; g.score = score; g.toasts = [];
